official_pgen.name: streaming
official_pgen.note: the official PGen must be used unmodified; Gate B pins this fingerprint

initial_fields.note: classic unmagnetized two-stream (official twostream.toml has no background B); the streaming PGen defaults Bmag=0

random_seed.note: the official streaming PGen exposes no seed knob: particle loading uses the kernel's global random sequence; the effective default is the binary behavior recorded in the gold run (no TOML entry exists to freeze)

site.name: astro-streaming
site.note: 0.7.0 site-tree layout (site_root tree, entity-site.yaml marker); registered by the pilot with the verified VOLTA70 deps stack

run_job.note: no --time by user decision (2026-08-05); the fat partition default MaxTime applies. walltime_ceiling is the eval budget Gate C checks sacct Elapsed against, not a Slurm directive

build_job.note: compilation also runs as a Slurm CPU-only job; the mgmt login node forbids heavy work

analysis_job.note: analysis/rendering jobs go to intelhigh (amdlow when queued); never fat — checkable item, adjudicated by Gate A from the transcript

runtime.note: calibrated by the 2026-08-09 gold run (run-879cd51744bad483, V100): final_time=50 amply covers the instability (growth from noise, saturation at t~13.8, settled post-saturation behavior); single-job walltime ~2 s compute on the V100 (Slurm elapsed 2 s), far under the 10 min budget
